padom.name: St. Stephen's Cathedral
padom.slogan: Baroque domes and an organ that fills the whole old town.
padom.line: Five organs by Eisenbarth, built 1978-1993, share 17,974 pipes and 229 registers, making Europe's largest organ.

paorts.name: Dreiflüsseeck
paorts.slogan: Three rivers, three colours, one quiet stone point.
paorts.line: The Danube meets the Inn from the south and the Ilz from the north, and the Old Town Hall wall marks floods back to 1501.

paoberhaus.name: Veste Oberhaus
paoberhaus.slogan: The prince-bishops' fortress watching over all three rivers.
paoberhaus.line: Founded in 1219 by Ulrich II, the first prince-bishop of Passau, it stands 105 metres above the valley floor.

paburghausenburg.name: Burghausen Castle
paburghausenburg.slogan: A kilometre of ramparts strung along a lakeside ridge.
paburghausenburg.line: At 1,051 metres, Guinness World Records confirmed it as the longest castle complex in the world.

pabaumwipfelpfad.name: Bavarian Forest Treetop Walk
pabaumwipfelpfad.slogan: Walk among the crowns of Germany's oldest national park forest.
pabaumwipfelpfad.line: Opened in 2009, the 1,300-metre path ends in a 44-metre egg-shaped tower and was then the longest treetop walk in the world.
